key.name: restore-playlist
key.description: Whether to load the playlist selected in the last session when the application starts; otherwise, it starts with an empty queue

key.name: selected-playlist
key.description: The name of the saved playlist that is played and that tracks are added to; empty for the queue

key.name: sleep-timer-minutes
key.description: The number of minutes the sleep timer was last set to

key.name: sleep-timer-finish-track
key.summary: Finish the last track when the sleep timer runs out
key.description: Whether the music stops at the end of the track that is playing when the sleep timer runs out, instead of right away

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: The width of the playlist sidebar, in pixels; 0 means the width is computed automatically

key.name: album-sort
key.summary: What the albums are sorted by
key.description: The albums in the grid are sorted by artist, title, year, or the date they were added to the Music folder

key.name: album-sort-order
key.summary: The direction the albums are sorted in
key.description: Whether the albums in the grid are sorted in ascending or descending order
